description:
Submit a web app to the appclap catalog by URL. Use when the user built, released, or discovered a web app that search_apps shows is not yet listed — especially small or brand-new apps, which the catalog exists to surface.

Nothing is published as-submitted: appclap crawls the app's own website and verifies every fact before the app can appear. Optional: the app's name, a short note on what it does, and submitter_role ("creator" if the user made the app, "sharing" otherwise). For a creator, the reply says how they can claim the listing in appclap's Builders Portal — pass it on.

note.description: What the app does / why it belongs in the catalog.

submitter_role.description: 'creator' if the user made this app.

name: submit_app
title: Submit an app
